notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR2: "Within a single program, the INITIAL clause may be specified in only one CD entry. The INITIAL clause must not be used in a program that specifies the USING phrase of the Procedure Division header." BindSection (run per program; no edition arm, the facility's 85..2014 interval is the edition pass's construct communication-facility-removed-2014) calls ScreenInitialClause, which refuses every INITIAL CD after the first (COBOL6169 at that CD) and an INITIAL CD in a program whose procedure division header has USING (COBOL6169 at USING); cdMode admits INITIAL only before INPUT or I-O. The witness refuses two INITIAL INPUT CDs. Probes at --std 85: (b) INITIAL INPUT plus INITIAL I-O refused COBOL6169 at the second CD; INITIAL INPUT and INITIAL I-O each with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING refused COBOL6169 at USING; FOR INITIAL OUTPUT and FOR INITIAL INITIAL INPUT refused COBOL5506; one INITIAL among three CDs accepted and printed P2C RAN; USING with a non-INITIAL CD accepted; nested OUTER and INNER each with one INITIAL CD accepted (each is a single program), printing OUTER and INNER. (c) the same program at --std 2023 refused COBOL0902 (facility removed in 2014), at --std 2002 warned COBOL0903 and ran. (a, d, e, f) not reached: the rule has no data operand, record, file or arithmetic. Every refusal's text cites ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex A rather than the 1985 rule, the cross-cutting citation matter kb/Work PB4950 decides; the outcome is the one the rule requires.

next.reason: 1985: "Within a single program, the INITIAL clause may be specified in only one CD entry."; 2023: "No 2023 candidate covers CD entries; the communication description entry with its INITIAL clause is absent.". None of the 2023 candidates covers the communication description entry or its INITIAL clause. The 2023 standard lacks the Communication module, so this requirement is dropped.
